purpose: This level is designed to help new learners understand how good project planning creates a clear path from an initial idea to a finished result. It introduces the basic planning habits needed to organize work, understand responsibilities, set realistic expectations, and avoid common problems caused by poor preparation.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、新しい学習者が良いプロジェクト計画は、完成した結果に最初のアイデアから明確なパスを作成する方法を理解するのに役立つように設計されています。 について紹介し、基本計画の習慣に必要な整理の仕事を理解し、責任、現実的な期待を避ける共通問題の貧しいです。
learn_info: You will learn how to define simple project goals, identify key deliverables, break work into manageable tasks, create basic timelines, assign responsibilities, identify important resources, and understand project dependencies. The course also introduces simple ways to organize project information and check whether planned work is moving forward as expected.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to create a simple project plan, organize tasks, identify who is responsible for each activity, set practical deadlines, and follow basic project progress. You will have a clearer understanding of how planning supports smoother project execution.

purpose: This level is designed for learners who already understand basic project planning and want to apply those skills to real workplace projects. The focus is on creating more detailed plans, managing changing requirements, coordinating people, and keeping project activities aligned with agreed goals and deadlines.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、すでに基本的なプロジェクト計画を理解し、実際の職場のプロジェクトにそれらのスキルを適用したい学習者のために設計され 焦点は、より詳細な計画を作成し、変化する要件を管理し、人々を調整し、合意された目標と期限に沿ったプロジェクト活動を維持することにあります。
learn_info: You will learn how to develop detailed work breakdown structures, connect task dependencies, set milestones, estimate resources, manage competing activities, and track planned versus actual progress. You will also explore how to update project plans when requirements change and how to communicate planning changes clearly with team members and stakeholders.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to build and maintain practical project plans for medium-sized projects. You will be more confident in managing dependencies, adjusting schedules, coordinating resources, identifying planning gaps, and keeping team members aware of what needs to happen and when.

purpose: This level focuses on project planning situations where work becomes more complicated because of multiple teams, limited resources, changing priorities, tight deadlines, or strong stakeholder expectations. It helps experienced professionals improve their ability to make planning decisions while balancing time, cost, quality, resources, and project objectives.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、複数のチーム、限られたリソース、優先順位の変更、厳しい期限、または強い利害関係者の期待のために作業がより複雑になるプロジェクト計画の状況に焦点を当てています。 これは、経験豊富な専門家が時間、コスト、品質、リソース、およびプロジェクトの目標のバランスをとりながら、計画決定を行う能力を向上させるのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will explore complex scheduling decisions, resource conflicts, changing scope, cross-team dependencies, delivery constraints, planning assumptions, and recovery planning. The course also covers how to compare different planning options, recognize potential schedule problems early, adjust plans without creating unnecessary disruption, and communicate important decisions to project stakeholders.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage complex planning situations with greater confidence. You will know how to adjust project plans when conditions change, balance competing priorities, resolve resource conflicts, and make practical decisions that protect important project deadlines and deliverables.

purpose: This level is intended for experienced project professionals who are responsible for shaping planning approaches across complex projects or supporting other project leaders. The focus moves beyond individual project plans toward improving planning practices, connecting projects with business priorities, and creating reliable delivery approaches across larger environments.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、複雑なプロジェクト全体で計画アプローチを形成したり、他のプロジェクトリーダーをサポートしたりする経験豊富なプロ 個々のプロジェクト計画を超えて、計画の実践を改善し、プロジェクトをビジネスの優先事項と結びつけ、より大きな環境全体で信頼性の高い配信ア
learn_info: You will explore strategic planning, planning standards, portfolio dependencies, resource capacity, delivery forecasting, project governance, planning performance, and long-term project coordination. You will also consider how organizations can improve planning consistency, use project information for better decisions, and support project managers when several important initiatives compete for resources.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to design stronger planning approaches for complex projects and guide other project professionals in their planning decisions. You will be better prepared to connect project plans with organizational priorities, improve planning practices, manage major dependencies, and support reliable delivery.

purpose: This level introduces the basic ideas behind project risk management and explains why identifying possible problems early can make projects easier to control. It is designed to help new learners recognize common risks, understand their possible effects, and develop the habit of thinking about risks before they become actual problems.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、プロジェクトリスク管理の背後にある基本的な考え方を紹介し、起こりうる問題を早期に特定することでプロジェクトを管理しやすくすることができる理由を説明します。 これは、新しい学習者が共通のリスクを認識し、その可能性のある影響を理解し、実際の問題になる前にリスクについて考える習慣を発達させるのを助けるように設計されています。
learn_info: You will learn how to identify common project risks, describe what may cause them, understand their possible impact, and record important information in a simple risk register. The course also introduces basic risk ownership, monitoring, communication, and response ideas using straightforward examples from everyday project situations.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to recognize common project risks and record them clearly. You will understand how to think about the likelihood and effect of a risk, suggest simple responses, and help a project team stay aware of potential problems during delivery.

purpose: This level helps learners move from simply identifying risks to actively managing them during project delivery. It focuses on practical risk assessment, response planning, ownership, and regular monitoring so that potential problems can be addressed before they cause serious effects on project goals.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、学習者が単にリスクを特定することから、プロジェクトの配信中にリスクを積極的に管理することに移行するのに役立ちます。 プロジェクトの目標に深刻な影響を与える前に潜在的な問題に対処できるように、実用的なリスク評価、対応計画、所有権、定期的な監視に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: You will learn how to assess risks using likelihood and impact, prioritize risks, maintain a useful risk register, assign owners, create response actions, and prepare contingency plans. You will also explore how to review risks during project meetings, communicate important changes, and track whether planned responses are actually helping.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to manage a working project risk process with greater confidence. You will know how to prioritize important risks, assign responsibility, create suitable response actions, review risk information regularly, and communicate emerging concerns before they seriously affect delivery.

purpose: This level focuses on managing risk in projects where uncertainty is higher and the possible consequences are more serious. It is suited to professionals who need to make decisions when projects involve several teams, major dependencies, changing conditions, limited resources, or significant business expectations.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、不確実性が高く、起こりうる結果がより深刻なプロジェクトにおけるリスク管理に焦点を当てています。 これは、プロジェクトが複数のチーム、主要な依存関係、変化する条件、限られたリソース、または重要なビジネス期待を伴う場合に意思決定を行う必要があ
learn_info: You will explore complex risk relationships, response trade-offs, secondary risks, escalation, contingency decisions, risk trends, and risks created by project changes. The course also looks at how to combine information from different teams, judge when a risk needs management attention, and decide when planned responses should be changed.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage complicated risk situations and make stronger response decisions. You will be better prepared to identify connected risks, judge their wider effects, coordinate responses across teams, recognize when escalation is needed, and keep risk management active throughout difficult projects.

purpose: This level is designed for senior professionals who need to influence how risk is handled across major projects, programs, or organizations. The focus is on creating stronger risk practices, improving decision-making, preparing organizations for uncertainty, and helping project leaders respond consistently to important threats and opportunities.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、主要なプロジェクト、プログラム、または組織全体でリスクがどのように処理されるかに影響を与える必要がある上級専門家を対象としています。 焦点は、より強力なリスク慣行を作成し、意思決定を改善し、不確実性のために組織を準備し、プロジェクトリーダーが重要な脅威と機会に一貫して対応するのを支援することにあります。
learn_info: You will explore enterprise-level risk thinking, risk culture, strategic uncertainty, risk appetite, major response decisions, portfolio-level risks, governance, and risk reporting. You will also examine how senior leaders can use risk information to support investment decisions, prepare for major changes, strengthen organizational readiness, and improve risk practices across multiple projects.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide risk management in complex project environments and support senior decision-makers with useful risk information. You will understand how to build stronger risk practices, manage major uncertainties, improve organizational readiness, and help project teams make informed decisions when conditions are uncertain.

purpose: This level helps new learners understand how project schedules and costs work together. It introduces the basic skills needed to organize project activities, set realistic dates, understand simple task relationships, estimate basic costs, and keep track of whether work and spending are following the original plan.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、新しい学習者がプロジェクトのスケジュールとコストがどのように連携するかを理解するのに役立ちます。 プロジェクト活動を整理し、現実的な日付を設定し、単純なタスクの関係を理解し、基本的なコストを推定し、仕事と支出が元の計画に従っているかどうかを追跡するために必要な基本的なスキルを紹介します。
learn_info: You will learn how to list project activities, arrange them in a logical order, estimate task durations, create milestones, identify simple dependencies, and build a basic schedule. You will also learn how project budgets are prepared, how expenses are recorded, and how simple differences between planned and actual spending can be identified.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to create a basic project schedule and understand the main parts of a project budget. You will know how to track deadlines and spending, recognize simple schedule or cost problems, and provide useful updates about project progress.

purpose: This level develops practical scheduling and cost control skills for learners working on real projects. The focus is on creating dependable schedules, understanding activity relationships, tracking budget performance, and responding to common changes that can affect project completion dates and spending.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、実際のプロジェクトに取り組む学習者のための実践的なスケジューリングとコスト管理スキルを開発しています。 信頼できるスケジュールの作成、アクティビティの関係の理解、予算のパフォーマンスの追跡、プロジェクトの完了日と支出に影響を与える可能性のある一般的な変更への対応に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: You will explore task dependencies, milestones, critical activities, resource planning, schedule updates, cost estimates, budget tracking, planned versus actual spending, and basic variance analysis. You will also learn how to identify delays and cost differences, understand their causes, and make practical adjustments while keeping stakeholders informed.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to manage project schedules and budgets with greater confidence. You will know how to identify important activities, track changes, review cost differences, update plans, and take practical action when projects begin moving away from their original schedule or budget.

purpose: This level is designed for professionals managing projects where schedules and budgets are affected by competing priorities, limited resources, changing requirements, or complex dependencies. It focuses on making informed decisions when protecting the original plan is no longer enough and adjustments are needed to keep delivery realistic.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、スケジュールと予算が競合する優先順位、限られたリソース、要件の変更、または複雑な依存関係の影響を受けるプロジェクトを管理する 当初の計画を保護するだけでは不十分であり、納品を現実的に保つために調整が必要な場合は、情報に基づいた意思決定に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: You will explore schedule recovery, resource conflicts, changing cost forecasts, complex dependencies, budget pressures, time and cost trade-offs, and performance trends. The course also covers how to compare recovery options, understand the effect of changes on delivery, and communicate difficult scheduling or budget decisions to stakeholders.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to handle difficult schedule and cost situations more effectively. You will know how to assess delays, manage resource conflicts, review recovery choices, control budget changes, and make balanced decisions that protect the most important project outcomes.

purpose: This level focuses on advanced control of schedules, budgets, and delivery performance across complex projects or groups of projects. It is intended for experienced professionals who need to improve forecasting, guide major planning decisions, and help organizations use time and financial resources more effectively.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、複雑なプロジェクトまたはプロジェクトグループ全体のスケジュール、予算、および配信パフォーマンスの高度な制御に焦点を当てています。 これは、予測を改善し、主要な計画決定を導き、組織が時間と財源をより効果的に使用するのを助ける必要がある経験豊富な専門家を対象としています。
learn_info: You will explore advanced forecasting, resource capacity, portfolio dependencies, delivery scenarios, cost trends, major schedule risks, performance information, governance, and planning improvement. You will also consider how senior project leaders can use schedule and cost data to support strategic choices, improve forecasting accuracy, and identify areas where organizational processes can be strengthened.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide complex scheduling and cost decisions with a broader business view. You will be prepared to improve forecasting, evaluate delivery scenarios, manage major resource pressures, support senior decisions, and strengthen schedule and cost control practices across projects.

purpose: This level introduces the importance of working well with people who are affected by or interested in a project. It helps new learners understand who stakeholders are, why their expectations matter, and how simple, clear communication can prevent confusion and support smoother project work.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、プロジェクトの影響を受けている、またはプロジェクトに興味を持っている人々とうまく働くことの重要性を紹介します。 これは、新しい学習者が利害関係者が誰であるか、彼らの期待が重要である理由、そしてどのようにシンプルで明確なコミュニケーションが混乱を防
learn_info: You will learn how to identify common project stakeholders, understand their basic needs, choose suitable ways to communicate, share project updates, listen to questions, and record important concerns. The course also introduces simple communication planning and explains how different stakeholders may need different types of information.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to identify key stakeholders and communicate with them more effectively. You will know how to prepare simple updates, understand basic stakeholder expectations, respond to questions, and contribute to positive working relationships throughout a project.

purpose: This level helps learners handle stakeholder relationships more actively during real project work. The focus is on understanding different interests, planning communication, managing expectations, responding to feedback, and keeping important people engaged without creating unnecessary communication or confusion.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、学習者が実際のプロジェクト作業中に利害関係者の関係をより積極的に処理するのに役立ちます。 焦点は、異なる興味を理解し、コミュニケーションを計画し、期待を管理し、フィードバックに応答し、不要なコミュニケーションや混乱を作成することなく、重要な人々が従事し続けることにあります。
learn_info: You will explore stakeholder mapping, communication planning, influence, expectations, feedback, meeting preparation, project reporting, and handling concerns. You will also learn how to adjust communication for different audiences, recognize when a stakeholder needs more attention, and keep conversations focused on useful project decisions and actions.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to manage stakeholder communication more confidently across a working project. You will know how to identify communication needs, handle changing expectations, respond to concerns, provide useful updates, and maintain stronger relationships with people who influence project success.

purpose: This level focuses on stakeholder situations where interests may conflict, expectations may change, or project decisions may create strong reactions. It is designed for professionals who need to build support, manage difficult conversations, and maintain productive relationships while dealing with complex project pressures.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、利害関係者が対立したり、期待が変わったり、プロジェクトの決定が強い反応を生み出す可能性のある状況に焦点を当てています。 これは、複雑なプロジェクトの圧力に対処しながら、サポートを構築し、困難な会話を管理し、生産的な関係を維持する必要がある専門家のために設計
learn_info: You will explore stakeholder influence, competing interests, communication challenges, resistance, difficult conversations, escalation, negotiation, and engagement strategies. The course also looks at how to prepare for sensitive discussions, understand stakeholder concerns, manage expectations during change, and communicate decisions when not everyone will agree with the outcome.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to handle challenging stakeholder situations with greater confidence and care. You will know how to manage resistance, address conflicting expectations, prepare difficult conversations, negotiate practical solutions, and maintain useful relationships even when project decisions are unpopular.

purpose: This level is intended for experienced project leaders who influence major stakeholders and guide communication across complex projects or organizations. The focus is on shaping stakeholder strategies, building long-term support, managing sensitive relationships, and helping project teams communicate consistently during important business changes.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、主要な利害関係者に影響を与え、複雑なプロジェクトや組織全体のコミュニケーションを導く経験豊富なプロジ 焦点は、利害関係者の戦略を形成し、長期的なサポートを構築し、敏感な関係を管理し、重要なビジネスの変更時にプロジェクトチームが一貫してコミュニケーシ
learn_info: You will explore stakeholder strategy, executive communication, influence networks, organizational relationships, major change communication, stakeholder risk, negotiation, and engagement across multiple initiatives. You will also consider how senior leaders can create communication standards, prepare teams for sensitive situations, build long-term stakeholder trust, and align different groups around important project outcomes.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to shape stakeholder strategies for complex projects and guide others through difficult communication situations. You will be better prepared to build executive support, manage influential relationships, handle major disagreements, and create communication approaches that support long-term project and organizational goals.

purpose: This level introduces the idea that a successful project should produce work that meets agreed expectations, not simply reach its final deadline. It helps new learners understand basic quality checks, project performance, simple measures, and the importance of finding problems early rather than waiting until the end.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、成功したプロジェクトは、単に最終期限に達するのではなく、合意された期待を満たす仕事を生み出すべきであるという考え これは、新しい学習者が基本的な品質チェック、プロジェクトのパフォーマンス、簡単な対策、および最後まで待つのではなく、早期に問題を見つけるこ
learn_info: You will learn how to understand basic quality expectations, check project work, identify common problems, track simple performance measures, review completed tasks, and record useful feedback. The course also introduces basic corrective action and explains how lessons from one project can help improve future work.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to take part in basic project quality and performance activities. You will know how to check whether work meets expectations, recognize simple performance problems, record findings, support corrective action, and contribute useful lessons for future project work.

purpose: This level helps learners take a more active role in managing project quality and performance during delivery. It focuses on setting useful measures, reviewing actual results, finding gaps, understanding their causes, and taking timely action before small problems become larger project issues.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、学習者が配信中にプロジェクトの品質とパフォーマンスを管理する上でより積極的な役割を果たすのに役立ちます。 それは、有用な措置を設定し、実際の結果を見直し、ギャップを見つけ、その原因を理解し、小さな問題がより大きなプロジェクトの問題になる前に時宜を得た行動を取ることに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: You will explore quality planning, performance measures, progress reviews, quality checks, issue tracking, corrective actions, feedback, and lessons learned. You will also learn how to compare planned and actual results, identify performance gaps, understand why problems occur, and communicate important findings to project stakeholders.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to monitor project quality and performance more effectively. You will know how to use useful measures, identify gaps, investigate common causes, recommend corrective actions, and support regular reviews that help keep project work aligned with agreed expectations.

purpose: This level focuses on managing quality and performance when projects have complex deliverables, multiple teams, changing requirements, or demanding stakeholder expectations. It helps experienced professionals move beyond basic checking and use performance information to understand deeper problems and improve how work is delivered.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、プロジェクトに複雑な成果物、複数のチーム、要件の変更、または利害関係者の期待を要求する場合の品質とパフォーマンスの管理に焦点を当てています。 これは、経験豊富な専門家が基本的なチェックを超えて移動し、より深い問題を理解し、仕事が配信される方法を改善するためにパフォーマ
learn_info: You will explore performance trends, quality risks, root causes, corrective and preventive actions, process improvement, delivery standards, team performance, and stakeholder expectations. The course also examines how to respond when quality problems repeat, how to balance quality with time and cost pressures, and how to use project lessons effectively.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to identify deeper quality and performance problems and take more effective action. You will know how to review trends, address repeated issues, balance competing project pressures, improve delivery practices, and help teams maintain stronger standards throughout complex projects.

purpose: This level is designed for senior professionals responsible for improving project performance and quality across complex programs or organizations. The focus is on building reliable ways of working, using performance information for strategic decisions, and creating a culture where teams continuously improve rather than simply fix individual problems.
purpose_jp: このレベルは上級専門家の責任の向上プロジェクトの性能と品質の複雑なプログラムまたは団体。 焦点は、作業の信頼性の高い方法を構築し、戦略的な意思決定のためのパフォーマンス情報を使用して、チームが継続的に個々の問題を修正するのではなく、
learn_info: You will explore performance governance, quality strategy, organizational standards, improvement systems, performance trends, project benchmarking, lessons across projects, and senior reporting. You will also consider how leaders can identify repeated organizational problems, improve delivery practices, strengthen accountability, and use project performance information to support wider business decisions.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide quality and performance improvement across complex project environments. You will be prepared to identify wider delivery patterns, strengthen quality practices, support strategic performance decisions, improve organizational learning, and help project leaders create more consistent and reliable results.

purpose: This level introduces the main ideas behind Agile project management and explains why some teams need a flexible way to organize and deliver work. It helps new learners understand short work cycles, regular feedback, teamwork, changing priorities, and the value of delivering useful results step by step.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、アジャイルプロジェクト管理の背後にある主なアイデアを紹介し、一部のチームが仕事を整理して提供する柔軟な方法を必要とす 新しい学習者は、短い作業サイクル、定期的なフィードバック、チームワーク、優先順位の変更、および有用な結果を段階的に提供する価値を理解するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will learn basic Agile ideas such as working in small pieces, reviewing progress regularly, responding to change, involving customers, and improving work through feedback. The course also introduces common Agile terms and simple examples showing how teams can plan and deliver work in shorter cycles.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand how Agile project management differs from a fixed approach. You will be able to take part in short planning cycles, respond to changing needs, discuss progress with a team, and contribute to regular delivery and improvement.

purpose: This level helps learners apply Agile practices in real project environments where requirements and priorities can change. The focus is on organizing work into manageable pieces, keeping customers involved, reviewing progress often, and helping teams make useful adjustments without losing direction.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、学習者が要件と優先順位が変わる可能性のある実際のプロジェクト環境でアジャイルプラクティスを適用するのに役立ちます。 焦点は、管理しやすい部分に作業を整理し、顧客を関与させ、頻繁に進捗状況を確認し、チームが方向性を失うことなく有用な調整を行うのを助けること
learn_info: You will explore iterative planning, backlog organization, prioritization, customer feedback, short delivery cycles, team coordination, progress reviews, and changing requirements. You will also learn how to decide what should be worked on next, communicate changes, and use regular feedback to improve both the product and the way the team works.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to apply Agile practices to active projects and changing work situations. You will know how to plan shorter cycles, manage changing priorities, involve customers, review progress, and help teams deliver useful results while remaining flexible.

purpose: This level focuses on applying Agile approaches when projects become more complex because of multiple teams, changing business needs, delivery pressures, or unclear requirements. It helps experienced professionals adapt Agile practices to real situations rather than treating Agile as a fixed set of meetings or rules.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、複数のチーム、ビジネスニーズの変化、配信圧力、または不明確な要件のためにプロジェクトがより複雑になったときに、アジャイルアプローチを適用することに焦点を当てています。 これは、経験豊富な専門家がアジャイルを固定された会議やルールのセットとして扱うのではなく、実際の状況にアジャイルプラクティスを適応させるのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will explore Agile planning across teams, changing priorities, delivery dependencies, team coordination, customer feedback, release planning, work visibility, and improvement practices. The course also examines common Agile problems such as unfinished work, unclear ownership, frequent changes, weak collaboration, and pressure to deliver quickly without enough learning.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to adapt Agile practices to more difficult project environments. You will know how to manage changing priorities, coordinate work across teams, improve delivery flow, respond to customer feedback, and help teams make practical decisions when normal Agile routines are not enough.

purpose: This level is designed for senior professionals leading Agile projects, transformations, or multiple teams. It focuses on using Agile thinking at a broader level, improving delivery systems, supporting organizational change, and creating conditions where teams can respond quickly while still maintaining clear business direction and accountability.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、アジャイルプロジェクト、トランスフォーメーション、または複数のチームをリードするシニアプロフェッショナル向けに設計されています。 より広範なレベルでアジャイル思考を使用し、デリバリーシステムを改善し、組織の変更をサポートし、明確なビジネス方向性と説明責任を維持しながら、チームが迅速に対応できる条件を作成することに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: You will explore Agile strategy, organizational change, scaling across teams, delivery systems, leadership, business alignment, customer value, performance measures, and continuous improvement. The course also considers how leaders can identify barriers to Agile ways of working, improve collaboration across departments, and create an environment where teams can adapt without losing strategic focus.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide Agile delivery in complex organizational environments. You will be better prepared to support large-scale change, improve how multiple teams work together, connect Agile delivery with business goals, and help leaders create practical conditions for sustainable Agile performance.

purpose: This level introduces the Scrum framework and helps new learners understand how Scrum teams organize and deliver work. It provides a simple view of Scrum roles, events, artifacts, and short development cycles so learners can understand how the different parts work together in everyday team situations.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、スクラムフレームワークを導入し、新しい学習者がスクラムチームがどのように作業を整理して提供するかを理解するのに役立ちます。 スクラムの役割、イベント、成果物、短い開発サイクルのシンプルなビューを提供するため、学習者は日常のチーム状況でさまざまな部分がどのように連携しているかを理解できます。
learn_info: You will learn about the Scrum Team, Product Owner, Scrum Master, product backlog, sprint, sprint planning, daily Scrum, sprint review, and retrospective. The course explains the purpose of each part using straightforward examples and shows how Scrum helps teams create visibility, review progress, and improve their way of working.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the main parts of Scrum and how they connect. You will be able to participate in Scrum events, understand basic responsibilities, follow sprint work, discuss backlog items, and contribute to a team that uses Scrum in a structured way.

purpose: This level moves beyond understanding Scrum terms and focuses on using the framework effectively within an active team. Learners will explore how Scrum events, backlog work, sprint goals, communication, and team collaboration can support regular delivery and help teams respond to changing needs.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、スクラム用語の理解を超えて、アクティブなチーム内でフレームワークを効果的に使用することに焦点を当てています。 学習者は、スクラムイベント、バックログ作業、スプリント目標、コミュニケーション、チームコラボレーションがどのように定期的な配信をサポートし、チームが変化するニーズに対応するのを助けることができるかを探ります。
learn_info: You will explore sprint planning, sprint goals, backlog refinement, daily Scrum discussions, sprint reviews, retrospectives, team responsibilities, and product value. The course also covers common issues such as unclear work, changing priorities, missed sprint goals, and weak communication, helping you understand how teams can improve their Scrum practices.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to work more effectively within a Scrum team and understand how its practices support delivery. You will know how to prepare for sprints, contribute to backlog discussions, support useful Scrum events, recognize common problems, and encourage continuous improvement.

purpose: This level focuses on Scrum teams facing more difficult delivery situations, such as complex products, multiple dependencies, changing priorities, or teams that are struggling to use Scrum effectively. It helps experienced professionals look beyond individual events and improve how the entire team works together.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、複雑な製品、複数の依存関係、優先順位の変更、スクラムの効果的な使用に苦労しているチームなど、より困難な配信状況に直面しているスクラムチームに焦点を当てています。 これは、経験豊富な専門家が個々のイベントを超えて見て、チーム全体が一緒に働く方法を改善するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will explore advanced backlog practices, sprint planning challenges, product goals, team collaboration, dependency management, delivery problems, Scrum adaptation, and improvement techniques. You will also examine situations where teams misunderstand Scrum, rely too heavily on meetings, struggle with ownership, or find it difficult to create a steady delivery rhythm.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to help Scrum teams handle more challenging delivery situations. You will know how to improve Scrum practices, address team problems, manage dependencies, strengthen collaboration, and support better use of Scrum without adding unnecessary processes.

purpose: This level is intended for experienced Agile professionals who need to guide Scrum adoption or improvement across complex products and organizations. The focus is on creating effective Scrum environments, improving team and product practices, and helping leaders understand where organizational structures may support or restrict successful Scrum delivery.
purpose_jp: このレベルは、複雑な製品や組織全体でスクラムの採用や改善を導く必要がある経験豊富なアジャイル専門家を対象としています。 焦点は、効果的なスクラム環境を作成し、チームと製品のプラクティスを改善し、組織構造がスクラム配信の成功をサポートまたは制限する可能性がある場
learn_info: You will explore Scrum at scale, product strategy, organizational dependencies, team structures, leadership, delivery performance, governance, improvement systems, and organizational barriers. You will also examine how experienced Scrum leaders can coach teams and decision-makers, identify weak practices, improve the wider delivery environment, and support sustainable use of Scrum.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide Scrum practices in complex environments and support meaningful improvement across teams. You will be prepared to identify organizational barriers, improve delivery systems, coach teams and leaders, and help create Scrum environments that support long-term product and business results.

purpose: This level introduces the role of a Scrum Master and explains how this person supports a Scrum team without becoming the team's manager. It helps new learners understand facilitation, teamwork, removing obstacles, communication, and the importance of helping people improve their own way of working.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、スクラムマスターの役割を紹介し、この人がチームのマネージャーにならずにスクラムチームをどのようにサポートするかを説明します。 それは、新しい学習者がファシリテーション、チームワーク、障害物の除去、コミュニケーション、そして人々が自分の働き方を改善するのを助けることの重要性を理解するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will learn what a Scrum Master does before, during, and after Scrum events. The course covers meeting facilitation, helping teams identify problems, supporting collaboration, removing simple obstacles, encouraging participation, and creating space for the team to discuss improvements openly.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the main responsibilities of a Scrum Master and how the role supports the team. You will be able to facilitate basic Scrum events, help identify obstacles, encourage communication, and support a team as it develops better working habits.

purpose: This level focuses on the practical work of supporting a Scrum team that is already using the framework. It helps learners deal with common team challenges, improve Scrum events, encourage shared responsibility, and create an environment where people can solve problems together instead of waiting for instructions.
purpose_jp: このレベルでは、すでにフレームワークを使用しているスクラムチームをサポートする実践的な作業に焦点を当てています。 これは、学習者が共通のチームの課題に対処し、スクラムイベントを改善し、責任の共有を奨励し、指示を待つのではなく、人々が一緒に問題を解決できる環境を作成するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: You will explore facilitation techniques, impediment management, team communication, conflict handling, coaching conversations, Scrum event improvement, team accountability, and continuous improvement. The course also looks at common challenges such as poor participation, unclear discussions, repeated obstacles, weak ownership, and teams that depend too heavily on the Scrum Master.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to support Scrum teams more effectively in everyday situations. You will know how to improve meetings, help teams address obstacles, encourage ownership, handle common disagreements, and create better habits that allow team members to solve problems together.

purpose: This level is designed for Scrum Masters working with teams that face difficult delivery, relationship, or organizational challenges. The focus is on helping teams become more independent, improving team behavior, addressing deeper problems, and working with stakeholders when issues extend beyond the team's immediate control.
learn_info: You will explore advanced facilitation, coaching, team development, conflict resolution, organizational impediments, stakeholder relationships, team dynamics, delivery patterns, and improvement conversations. You will learn how to recognize repeated problems, understand what is causing them, support difficult discussions, and work with others to remove barriers that prevent the team from progressing.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to handle more complex Scrum Master situations with confidence. You will know how to coach teams through difficult problems, improve team relationships, address organizational obstacles, support stakeholder conversations, and help teams become more self-managing and consistent in their delivery.

purpose: This level focuses on the role of an experienced Scrum leader who helps improve Agile ways of working beyond a single team. It is designed for professionals who coach other Scrum Masters, influence organizational practices, and help create conditions that allow teams to deliver value effectively and sustainably.
learn_info: You will explore advanced coaching, organizational change, Agile leadership, team structures, organizational impediments, Scrum adoption, leadership behavior, delivery systems, and continuous improvement at scale. You will also examine how experienced Scrum leaders can influence managers and decision-makers, support multiple teams, identify systemic problems, and guide meaningful improvements without creating unnecessary control.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to support Scrum improvement at a broader organizational level. You will be prepared to coach Scrum Masters and teams, identify systemic problems, influence leadership behavior, improve Agile working conditions, and guide sustainable improvements across complex delivery environments.

purpose: This level introduces the Product Owner role and explains how this person helps a product team decide what work should be done and why it matters. It is designed for learners who want to understand how customer needs, business goals, and team work come together when building a product.
learn_info: You will learn about product goals, customer needs, product backlogs, backlog items, priorities, stakeholder communication, and the main responsibilities of a Product Owner. The course also introduces simple ways to organize backlog work, understand requests, and keep attention on the most useful product outcomes.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the main responsibilities of a Product Owner and how the role supports a product team. You will be able to work with basic backlog items, understand priorities, communicate product needs, and contribute to clearer product decisions.

purpose: This level helps learners move from understanding the Product Owner role to applying it in everyday product work. The focus is on making practical backlog decisions, balancing different requests, understanding customer value, and keeping the team focused on work that supports important product goals.
learn_info: You will explore backlog ordering, product goals, stakeholder requests, customer feedback, feature value, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, release planning, and communication with delivery teams. You will also learn how to handle competing requests and explain why some work should be completed before other work.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to manage a product backlog more effectively and make practical priority decisions. You will know how to connect backlog work with customer and business needs, communicate decisions clearly, and provide useful direction to the product team.

purpose: This level focuses on Product Owners working with larger products, competing stakeholder interests, uncertain customer needs, and frequent changes in business priorities. It helps experienced professionals make stronger product decisions while keeping the team focused on meaningful outcomes rather than simply completing more features.
learn_info: You will explore product goals, outcome-based prioritization, stakeholder influence, backlog strategy, customer feedback, release choices, competing business needs, and difficult product trade-offs. The course also examines how to decide what should not be built, how to handle pressure from stakeholders, and how to keep product decisions connected to customer value.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage complex product ownership situations with greater confidence. You will be prepared to balance competing needs, make difficult backlog decisions, protect product focus, handle stakeholder pressure, and guide teams toward work that creates meaningful customer and business value.

purpose: This level is designed for experienced Product Owners and product leaders who influence product direction across complex environments. The focus is on connecting product ownership with wider business strategy, shaping decision-making practices, and creating a product environment where teams can focus on outcomes and long-term value.
learn_info: You will explore product strategy, portfolio priorities, outcome management, product governance, stakeholder influence, investment decisions, customer value, organizational alignment, and product leadership. The course also considers how senior product leaders can improve product decision-making, guide other Product Owners, and create stronger connections between product work and business performance.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide product ownership in complex business environments. You will understand how to connect product decisions with strategy, influence senior stakeholders, improve product decision-making, support other product professionals, and help teams focus on measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.

purpose: This level introduces user stories and sprint planning in a simple and practical way. It helps learners understand how customer needs can be turned into small pieces of work and how teams use those pieces to decide what can realistically be completed during a sprint.
learn_info: You will learn the basic structure of a user story, how to describe a customer need, what acceptance criteria are, and how stories can be broken into smaller pieces. The course also introduces sprint goals, simple estimation, backlog refinement, and the main steps involved in preparing a sprint.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to write simple user stories and describe what a completed piece of work should achieve. You will also understand the purpose of sprint planning and be able to contribute to basic discussions about the work a team can complete.

purpose: This level develops practical skills for preparing user stories and planning meaningful sprints. It is designed for learners who already understand basic Agile concepts and want to improve how requirements are discussed, refined, estimated, and prepared before development work begins.
learn_info: You will explore clear story writing, acceptance criteria, splitting large stories, backlog refinement, estimation discussions, sprint goals, team capacity, dependencies, and selecting suitable work for a sprint. You will also look at common story problems and ways to improve unclear or overly large backlog items before they reach the team.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to prepare stronger user stories and participate more effectively in sprint planning. You will know how to improve acceptance criteria, break down larger work, support realistic sprint choices, and help the team build a clearer understanding of what needs to be delivered.

purpose: This level focuses on user stories and sprint planning when products have complex requirements, uncertain work, technical dependencies, and changing priorities. It helps experienced professionals improve planning discussions while making sure the team understands the purpose and expected value of the work being selected.
learn_info: You will explore complex story splitting, dependencies, unclear requirements, estimation challenges, changing priorities, sprint goals, capacity limits, technical work, and backlog readiness. The course also covers how to identify stories that are not ready, manage uncertainty, and make practical planning choices when teams cannot predict every detail in advance.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to handle difficult story and sprint planning situations more effectively. You will know how to improve unclear requirements, manage dependencies, balance capacity, deal with uncertainty, and help teams create realistic sprint plans without losing sight of customer value.

purpose: This level is intended for experienced Agile professionals who shape how product teams prepare work and plan delivery. The focus is on improving planning quality across complex products, helping teams make better decisions under uncertainty, and creating practices that support sustainable delivery rather than short-term pressure.
learn_info: You will explore advanced backlog readiness, planning across teams, product outcomes, dependency management, forecasting, capacity planning, uncertainty, delivery patterns, and planning improvement. You will also examine how senior practitioners can coach teams, identify weak planning habits, improve collaboration between product and delivery groups, and establish healthier planning practices across larger environments.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide effective story preparation and sprint planning in complex environments. You will be prepared to improve planning practices, support teams facing uncertainty, manage cross-team dependencies, strengthen forecasting, and help organizations build more reliable and sustainable delivery habits.

purpose: This level introduces the process of discovering customer needs before deciding what product to build. It helps learners understand why talking to customers and testing ideas early can prevent wasted effort and lead to products that solve real problems instead of problems based only on assumptions.
learn_info: You will learn simple customer research methods such as interviews, surveys, observation, feedback collection, competitor research, and basic idea testing. The course also introduces ways to identify customer problems, organize research findings, compare different needs, and recognize the difference between what customers say they want and what they actually need.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to plan simple customer research and use basic findings to understand product opportunities. You will know how to ask useful questions, identify common customer problems, collect feedback, and use what you discover to support early product decisions.

purpose: This level helps learners use customer research more effectively when making product decisions. The focus is on choosing suitable research methods, asking better questions, identifying patterns, testing assumptions, and turning customer feedback into useful information for product teams and business stakeholders.
learn_info: You will explore customer interviews, surveys, observation, competitor analysis, research planning, problem validation, feedback analysis, customer segments, and simple product experiments. You will also learn how to organize findings, identify repeated problems, avoid leading questions, and decide when there is enough evidence to support or question a product idea.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to carry out more structured customer research and use findings in product discussions. You will know how to choose research methods, recognize useful patterns, test assumptions, summarize evidence, and help product teams make decisions based on real customer information.

purpose: This level focuses on product discovery when customer problems are unclear, research findings conflict, markets are changing, or teams are considering several possible product directions. It helps experienced professionals use evidence more carefully and avoid making major product decisions based on limited or unreliable feedback.
learn_info: You will explore problem discovery, customer segmentation, research bias, mixed feedback, competitor behavior, opportunity evaluation, product experiments, assumption testing, and evidence-based decision-making. The course also looks at situations where research does not provide a simple answer and explains how teams can combine different sources of information before choosing a direction.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage more difficult discovery situations and judge customer evidence more carefully. You will be prepared to investigate uncertain problems, challenge assumptions, compare opportunities, design useful experiments, and guide product decisions when customer information is incomplete or conflicting.

purpose: This level is designed for senior product professionals who shape discovery practices and influence how organizations understand customers. The focus is on building strong discovery habits across teams, connecting research with strategy, and making sure major product decisions are supported by useful evidence rather than assumptions.
learn_info: You will explore discovery strategy, research systems, customer insight, opportunity assessment, experimentation, evidence quality, market signals, organizational learning, and product decision-making. The course also considers how leaders can create better research practices, support product teams, challenge weak assumptions, and connect customer understanding with wider business and product strategy.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide product discovery at a strategic level and improve how organizations use customer information. You will know how to evaluate evidence, shape discovery practices, guide important product decisions, support product teams, and connect customer insights with long-term product direction.

purpose: This level introduces product strategy and explains how a product can have a clear direction instead of simply collecting a long list of features. It helps learners understand the connection between customer needs, business goals, product priorities, and the future direction of a product.
learn_info: You will learn about product goals, customer problems, target users, product priorities, simple roadmaps, planned releases, and business objectives. The course introduces basic ways to organize product direction and communicate what the team is trying to achieve without making the roadmap difficult to understand or maintain.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the purpose of product strategy and roadmaps. You will be able to describe basic product goals, identify important customer needs, organize simple priorities, create a basic roadmap, and explain the product direction to team members and stakeholders.

purpose: This level helps learners turn product goals into a practical roadmap that teams can use for planning and communication. The focus is on balancing customer needs, business priorities, available resources, and delivery timing while keeping the product direction clear when circumstances change.
learn_info: You will explore product goals, customer problems, roadmap themes, priorities, release planning, dependencies, business needs, stakeholder expectations, and roadmap communication. You will also learn how to update roadmaps when new information appears and how to avoid making promises based on dates or features that are not yet certain.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to create and maintain a practical product roadmap. You will know how to connect priorities with product goals, organize planned releases, communicate direction, manage changing expectations, and adjust roadmap decisions when customer or business needs change.

purpose: This level focuses on product strategy and roadmap planning when products face strong competition, uncertain markets, changing business goals, limited resources, or several possible growth opportunities. It helps experienced professionals make strategic choices instead of trying to include every possible idea in the product plan.
learn_info: You will explore product positioning, strategic priorities, customer segments, business outcomes, roadmap choices, release scenarios, market changes, resource limits, dependencies, and product trade-offs. The course also covers how to evaluate different strategic paths, decide what deserves investment, and communicate difficult roadmap decisions to senior stakeholders and delivery teams.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to build stronger product strategies and make better roadmap decisions in uncertain situations. You will know how to balance opportunities, resources, customer needs, and business goals while explaining why certain product directions deserve attention and others should wait.

purpose: This level is intended for senior product leaders responsible for shaping product direction across major products, portfolios, or business areas. The focus is on long-term product choices, business alignment, investment decisions, market opportunities, and creating roadmap practices that support sustainable product growth.
learn_info: You will explore portfolio direction, product investment, strategic positioning, market opportunities, business alignment, product outcomes, roadmap governance, organizational priorities, and long-term planning. You will also examine how senior leaders can guide product strategy across teams, manage competing investments, respond to market changes, and create clearer links between product decisions and business performance.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to shape product strategy and roadmap decisions at a broader business level. You will be prepared to evaluate major opportunities, guide investment choices, align products with organizational goals, influence senior stakeholders, and create product direction that can remain useful as markets and priorities change.

purpose: This level introduces product requirements and explains why clear documentation is important when turning an idea into something a team can build. It helps learners understand how to describe a problem, identify user needs, explain features, and give teams enough information to begin useful product conversations.
learn_info: You will learn the basic parts of a product requirements document, including the problem, target users, goals, feature details, requirements, assumptions, and expected outcomes. The course also introduces simple ways to organize requirements and write information that is easy for product, design, technology, and business teams to understand.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to create a simple product requirements document and describe product needs clearly. You will understand how to explain the problem, identify users, describe expected features, and provide useful information that helps a team understand what needs to be built.

purpose: This level develops practical skills for writing product requirements that different teams can use during development. The focus is on removing ambiguity, explaining user needs clearly, defining expected behavior, and making sure product requirements provide enough detail without becoming unnecessarily difficult to maintain.
learn_info: You will explore PRD structure, user needs, feature requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, success measures, and expected outcomes. You will also learn how to review requirements, identify unclear statements, manage changes, and work with designers, developers, testers, and stakeholders to improve shared understanding.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to write clearer and more useful product requirements for real projects. You will know how to identify missing information, improve unclear requirements, document important decisions, manage changes, and create PRDs that support smoother collaboration across product and delivery teams.

purpose: This level focuses on requirements for products where features are complex, teams are cross-functional, customer needs are uncertain, or requirements change during development. It helps experienced professionals create useful documentation without slowing teams down and manage differences between business expectations and practical delivery needs.
learn_info: You will explore complex requirements, business rules, dependencies, edge cases, changing needs, acceptance conditions, success measures, stakeholder disagreements, and requirement traceability. The course also examines how to decide what level of detail is useful, manage requirement changes, resolve unclear expectations, and keep product documentation connected to actual customer and business needs.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage complex product requirements with greater confidence. You will know how to handle changing needs, clarify difficult requirements, identify gaps, manage stakeholder differences, and create documentation that gives teams useful direction without creating unnecessary work.

purpose: This level is designed for experienced product leaders who need to improve how requirements are created and managed across complex products and organizations. The focus is on establishing better practices, supporting decision-making, and keeping product documentation connected to strategy, customer value, and delivery realities.
learn_info: You will explore requirements strategy, product governance, complex stakeholder needs, requirement quality, cross-team dependencies, product outcomes, documentation standards, decision records, and organizational practices. You will also consider how senior product professionals can coach teams, improve requirement processes, reduce repeated misunderstandings, and create stronger connections between product strategy and detailed delivery decisions.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide product requirements across complex environments and improve how teams work with product information. You will be prepared to establish useful practices, resolve difficult requirement issues, support other product professionals, and ensure detailed product decisions remain connected to wider business and customer goals.

purpose: This level introduces product prioritization and explains why teams need to choose carefully when there are more ideas than time or resources. It helps learners understand how customer needs, business value, effort, and timing can influence decisions about which product work should come first.
learn_info: You will learn simple ways to compare product ideas and features, understand customer value, consider business importance, estimate effort at a basic level, and organize priorities. The course also introduces practical discussions around trade-offs and explains why saying no or waiting can sometimes be necessary for a product team.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to make simple product priority decisions using clear reasons. You will understand how to compare features, consider customer and business needs, discuss trade-offs, and explain why certain work should be completed sooner than other possible product ideas.

purpose: This level helps learners make more structured product decisions when several features or opportunities compete for attention. It focuses on comparing value, effort, risk, customer needs, and business impact while giving teams a practical way to discuss and explain their priorities.
learn_info: You will explore prioritization criteria, customer value, business impact, effort, risk, urgency, opportunity cost, feature comparisons, and stakeholder discussions. You will also learn how to use simple prioritization methods, review changing information, challenge weak assumptions, and communicate priority decisions without creating unnecessary disagreement within the team.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to prioritize product work more consistently and explain your choices clearly. You will know how to compare competing opportunities, balance customer and business needs, consider effort and risk, and adjust priorities when new information changes the situation.

purpose: This level focuses on prioritization when product teams face limited resources, competing business goals, uncertain outcomes, strong stakeholder pressure, or several attractive opportunities. It helps experienced professionals make difficult trade-offs while protecting the product direction and avoiding decisions based only on personal preference or seniority.
learn_info: You will explore opportunity cost, strategic value, customer impact, business outcomes, risk, effort, timing, dependencies, stakeholder influence, and priority trade-offs. The course also examines how to compare different investment choices, challenge feature requests, respond to changing information, and build agreement around decisions that may disappoint some stakeholders.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to make stronger prioritization decisions in complex product environments. You will be prepared to balance competing interests, evaluate investment choices, handle stakeholder pressure, explain difficult trade-offs, and keep product priorities connected to meaningful customer and business outcomes.

purpose: This level is designed for senior product professionals who make or influence major investment and prioritization decisions across products or portfolios. The focus is on choosing where limited organizational resources can create the greatest value while maintaining a clear connection between product choices and business strategy.
learn_info: You will explore portfolio prioritization, investment choices, strategic opportunities, product outcomes, resource allocation, business value, risk, opportunity cost, market conditions, and executive decision-making. The course also considers how senior leaders can create better prioritization practices, challenge weak investment cases, guide product teams, and balance short-term needs with longer-term product growth.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide product prioritization at a strategic level. You will know how to evaluate major opportunities, balance investments across products, support executive decisions, improve prioritization practices, and ensure limited resources are directed toward work that offers meaningful customer and business value.

purpose: This level introduces the main stages of a product's life and explains how a product can change after it is launched. It helps learners understand that products need different types of attention as they move from early development and launch toward growth, improvement, maturity, or a new direction.
learn_info: You will learn about product launch, adoption, growth, maturity, improvement, customer feedback, product performance, and basic portfolio ideas. The course also introduces simple ways to review whether a product is meeting expectations and why product teams may need to change features, messaging, investment, or priorities over time.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the basic product lifecycle and why product decisions change over time. You will be able to recognize different product stages, discuss simple performance signals, identify areas that may need improvement, and understand the basic purpose of managing several products together.

purpose: This level helps learners manage products more actively as customer behavior, competition, performance, and business priorities change. The focus is on reviewing product health, deciding where improvements are needed, and balancing attention across different products or product areas.
learn_info: You will explore product lifecycle stages, adoption, customer retention, product performance, feature improvements, product health, portfolio priorities, investment needs, and market changes. You will also learn how to use product information to identify opportunities, decide where effort should go, and communicate product decisions to business and delivery teams.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to review products more effectively and make practical lifecycle decisions. You will know how to identify products that need improvement, understand changing customer needs, compare product priorities, and support decisions about investment, growth, maintenance, and future direction.

purpose: This level focuses on managing product portfolios and lifecycle decisions when products compete for customers, funding, people, and leadership attention. It helps experienced professionals look beyond individual features and consider how products perform together and how investment choices affect the wider business.
learn_info: You will explore portfolio balance, product performance, investment choices, lifecycle transitions, product overlap, market changes, growth opportunities, declining products, customer retention, and strategic priorities. The course also examines how to decide when a product should receive more investment, remain stable, be changed significantly, or move toward retirement.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to make more informed lifecycle and portfolio decisions. You will know how to compare products, identify investment opportunities, recognize declining performance, manage overlapping offerings, and recommend practical actions that support stronger overall product and business performance.

purpose: This level is intended for senior product leaders responsible for managing product portfolios and making long-term investment choices. The focus is on balancing growth, customer value, business performance, and organizational resources while shaping a portfolio that can remain competitive as markets and customer needs change.
learn_info: You will explore portfolio strategy, product investment, market positioning, portfolio balance, product performance, lifecycle transitions, organizational priorities, growth opportunities, product retirement, and long-term planning. You will also consider how senior leaders can guide portfolio reviews, make difficult investment decisions, align product groups, and build stronger connections between product performance and business strategy.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide product lifecycle and portfolio decisions at a strategic level. You will be prepared to evaluate major investments, manage portfolio balance, recognize when products need a new direction, support senior decisions, and shape a product portfolio that supports long-term business goals.

purpose: This level introduces business analysis as a practical way to understand problems before deciding on solutions. It helps new learners understand how business analysts work with people, information, processes, and goals to clarify what an organization needs and support better decisions.
learn_info: You will learn how to identify business problems, understand goals, speak with stakeholders, gather basic information, review current ways of working, identify needs, and describe possible solutions. The course also introduces simple analysis techniques and explains how business analysis can help prevent teams from solving the wrong problem.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will understand the basic purpose of business analysis and the role of a business analyst. You will be able to identify simple business needs, ask useful questions, collect information, describe problems clearly, and contribute to discussions about possible solutions.

purpose: This level helps learners apply business analysis techniques to real workplace situations where problems may involve several people, processes, or business needs. The focus is on understanding the current situation, identifying gaps, gathering useful information, and helping teams agree on practical solutions.
learn_info: You will explore stakeholder analysis, problem definition, requirements, process review, current and future states, gap analysis, solution options, business goals, and decision-making. You will also learn how to organize findings, compare possible solutions, ask better questions, and communicate analysis results in a way that different stakeholders can understand.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to carry out structured business analysis for common projects and business changes. You will know how to investigate problems, understand stakeholder needs, identify gaps, compare solution options, and provide useful analysis that supports clearer business decisions.

purpose: This level focuses on business analysis when problems are unclear, stakeholders disagree, processes cross several departments, or proposed solutions may affect important business operations. It helps experienced analysts look deeper into problems and provide useful recommendations when there is no simple answer.
learn_info: You will explore complex problem analysis, stakeholder interests, business rules, process gaps, solution evaluation, dependencies, assumptions, constraints, change impacts, and recommendation building. The course also examines how to challenge unclear requests, separate symptoms from root problems, evaluate different solution approaches, and help stakeholders reach practical decisions.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to manage more complicated business analysis work with confidence. You will know how to investigate unclear problems, evaluate business impacts, manage conflicting needs, compare solution options, and provide recommendations that are supported by clear analysis and useful evidence.

purpose: This level is designed for experienced business analysts and leaders who influence major business changes and complex solution decisions. The focus is on using analysis to support strategic choices, improve organizational processes, guide teams, and connect business needs with long-term organizational goals.
learn_info: You will explore strategic business analysis, organizational change, business architecture, complex stakeholder environments, solution strategy, process improvement, decision support, business value, and analysis governance. You will also examine how senior analysts can guide analysis teams, improve organizational practices, challenge major assumptions, and help leaders understand the wider effects of important business decisions.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to lead business analysis in complex organizational environments. You will be prepared to support strategic decisions, guide other analysts, evaluate major business changes, improve analysis practices, and connect detailed business needs with wider organizational priorities and long-term value.

purpose: This level introduces the basic ideas behind collecting information from people who know the business, use a product, or are affected by a change. It helps new learners understand why asking the right questions, listening carefully, and recording useful information are important parts of good requirements work.
learn_info: You will learn simple requirements gathering methods such as interviews, surveys, workshops, observation, document reviews, and informal discussions. The course explains how to prepare questions, identify important information, record what stakeholders say, and separate useful requirements from general comments or personal preferences.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to take part in basic requirements gathering activities and collect useful information from stakeholders. You will know how to prepare simple questions, listen for important needs, record findings clearly, and help a team build a better understanding of what is required.

purpose: This level helps learners move from basic information gathering to more structured requirements work. It focuses on choosing suitable techniques for different situations, dealing with different stakeholder views, and making sure important business needs are understood before work moves into solution design or delivery.
learn_info: You will explore stakeholder interviews, facilitated workshops, surveys, observation, document analysis, requirements discussions, and follow-up questions. You will also learn how to deal with incomplete answers, conflicting requests, unclear needs, and changing information while keeping requirements organized and connected to the original business problem.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to plan and conduct more effective requirements gathering activities. You will know how to choose suitable techniques, ask better follow-up questions, handle different stakeholder opinions, identify missing information, and organize findings so they can be reviewed and used by the project team.

purpose: This level is designed for professionals working with complex requirements where different departments, user groups, or stakeholders may have very different expectations. The focus is on uncovering the real need behind requests, resolving unclear information, and creating a reliable understanding before major business or technology decisions are made.
learn_info: You will explore advanced interviews, workshops, stakeholder analysis, conflicting requirements, hidden needs, assumptions, business rules, requirement validation, and difficult conversations. The course also covers how to challenge unclear requests respectfully, investigate the reasons behind them, compare different viewpoints, and confirm that gathered information accurately represents the underlying business need.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to handle difficult requirements gathering situations with greater confidence. You will be prepared to uncover hidden needs, manage conflicting views, challenge unclear requests, validate important information, and create a stronger foundation for solution planning and delivery.

purpose: This level focuses on senior professionals who lead requirements activities across complex projects, programs, or organizations. It moves beyond individual interviews and workshops toward building reliable ways of gathering information, improving stakeholder involvement, and creating consistent practices that support better business and technology decisions.
learn_info: You will explore requirements strategy, stakeholder engagement models, discovery planning, organizational communication, complex workshops, requirements governance, decision-making, and information quality. The course also considers how experienced professionals can coach analysts, improve requirements practices, manage large stakeholder groups, and create stronger links between business needs and organizational priorities.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide requirements gathering across complex environments and support other analysts in difficult situations. You will know how to shape discovery approaches, improve stakeholder participation, strengthen information quality, and ensure important business needs are understood before major decisions are made.

purpose: This level helps learners understand how everyday business work can be represented as a process. It introduces the simple idea of looking at each step from beginning to end so that unnecessary work, delays, repeated activities, and unclear responsibilities can be easier to see and discuss.
learn_info: You will learn how to identify process steps, people involved, inputs, outputs, decisions, and handoffs. The course introduces basic process maps and simple methods for reviewing how work is currently completed. Examples will show how visualizing a process can make problems easier to recognize and explain.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to create a simple process map and describe how a business activity moves from one step to another. You will also be able to spot obvious delays, repeated work, unclear responsibilities, and other basic opportunities for improvement.

purpose: This level develops practical process improvement skills for learners who already understand basic process mapping. The focus is on looking closely at how work happens, finding the reasons behind common problems, and suggesting improvements that make processes easier, faster, and more reliable.
learn_info: You will explore current-state and future-state process maps, bottlenecks, unnecessary steps, handoffs, duplication, waiting time, responsibilities, process measures, and improvement opportunities. You will also learn how to compare the existing process with a better future approach and discuss proposed changes with the people who perform the work.
outcome: By completing this level, you will be able to analyze everyday business processes and recommend practical improvements. You will know how to identify weak points, understand where delays come from, redesign simple workflows, clarify responsibilities, and explain process changes in a way that supports agreement among stakeholders.

purpose: This level focuses on process improvement when workflows cross departments, depend on several systems, or contain problems that are not visible from a single team's perspective. It helps experienced learners look at the wider process, understand connections between activities, and improve performance without creating new problems elsewhere.
learn_info: You will explore cross-functional processes, bottlenecks, process dependencies, handoffs, root causes, process measures, workflow redesign, automation opportunities, controls, and change impacts. The course also examines how improving one part of a process can affect another and how to compare improvement options before recommending a new way of working.
outcome: By the end of this level, you will be able to analyze and improve more complicated business processes. You will be prepared to find deeper causes of process problems, understand cross-team effects, evaluate improvement options, and recommend changes that improve the overall flow of work rather than only fixing one isolated step.

purpose: This level is intended for senior analysts and leaders who influence process improvement across departments or organizations. The focus is on improving important business processes at a broader level while considering customer experience, operating costs, technology, people, controls, and long-term business goals.
learn_info: You will explore enterprise process improvement, process ownership, operating models, performance measures, automation, digital change, process governance, customer journeys, and continuous improvement. The course also looks at how leaders can identify patterns across processes, prioritize improvement opportunities, guide major redesign efforts, and create practices that keep processes effective as business needs change.
outcome: After completing this level, you will be able to guide process improvement across complex business environments. You will know how to prioritize major opportunities, connect process changes with business goals, evaluate wider impacts, support large improvement initiatives, and help organizations build better ways of working that can continue to improve over time.

purpose: This level introduces business requirements documentation and explains why written requirements help people share the same understanding of a project.
